observations: body L4, L9, L22, L33: the heads of the four groups are italic and stand at the left margin; the entries are indented as the first line of a paragraph.

body L5-L40: the page ranges are printed with two sorts of dash: hyphens 3.1-3.5 pt long and 1.3-1.6 pt thick (L5-L7, L14, L30, L32, L34, L35, L39, L40; in L18 a hyphen of the same thickness, 4.0 pt long), and the thin long dash, 3.7-4.3 pt long and 1.0-1.2 pt thick (L8, L10, L12, L16, L23, L24, L26, L27, L29, L31, L37, L38), set as long dashes, as on p. VIII and in the commentary of Part I (p. 214). The true long dash of the text (p. VII, «274–277») measures 5.6 pt.

body L13, L19, L24, L38: the D of «Dimidia» prints broken, like «l)»; a tick over the first u of «ortuum» is a speck, not an accent; the stop after «72–77» has a speck joined to it; the 9 of «139» prints broken.
body L23, L25, L32: the signs of the Sun and the Moon, ⊙ and ☾, as printed.
body: the signature «2*» stands at the foot of the page, at the right; its asterisk prints as a heavy star.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
